text:
Researchers at the Institute for Medieval Textual Studies in Karlovac have confirmed that the Voskresen manuscript was written in Old Church Slavonic.

The finding was formally announced on 14 March 2023, when the Institute presented its 94-page "Voskresen Codex Linguistic Survey" at its spring symposium. The survey concludes that all 212 parchment folios of the codex are written in Old Church Slavonic, with no sections in any other language.

Dr. Ilyana Verchenko, lead paleographer at the Institute, said the result settles a question that had occupied specialists for some time.

"The evidence is consistent from the first folio to the last," Dr. Verchenko said. "This is a text in Old Church Slavonic throughout, and the survey sets out the grounds for that conclusion in full."

The report was presented to symposium attendees alongside the Institute's other spring research. The Institute said the survey will serve as a reference for further study of the manuscript.
